name: Question 3
problem: A gas station offers two types of gasoline, regular and premium. On a certain day, of the $43$ customers who bought regular gas, $23$ paid with a credit card. On the same day, of the $38$ customers that bought premium gas, $31$ of them paid with a credit card. What is the probability of a randomly selected customer paying with a credit card?
